purpose: Extract candidate leading signals from unlike historical trend explosions, then prospectively test them on unseen cases without rewriting history.

cases.name: LABUBU_THE_MONSTERS
observed_mechanisms: existing niche fandom before global explosion
evidence_notes: POP MART 2024 annual reporting describes LABUBU as particularly strong and highlights Thailand cultural-ambassador activity, frequent fan interaction, global events and IP globalization.
Later reporting records celebrity endorsement and a large secondary-market auction outcome, which are outcome-stage evidence and must not be treated as early signals.

cases.name: STANLEY_QUENCHER
observed_mechanisms: organic word of mouth and social sharing
evidence_notes: Stanley leadership attributed growth to early adopter affiliates, influencers, tastemakers, organic word of mouth and community engagement.
Later viral view counts and revenue are outcome-stage confirmation, not valid early-signal labels.

cases.name: DUBAI_CHOCOLATE
evidence_notes: AP reporting traces the concept to a UAE startup and describes Instagram/TikTok-driven spread before broad retail imitation.
Large retailer entry and sharply higher pistachio-filled chocolate sales are late-stage confirmation and should be separated from leading signals.

candidate_cross_case_signals: small but engaged community before mass awareness
acceleration in creator/tastemaker adoption rather than raw follower count
strong visual or demonstrable signature that is easy to imitate
mainstream retail expansion as confirmation, not earliest detection
anti_hindsight_rules: freeze signal definitions before prospectively scoring unseen cases
do not use later sales, auction prices, celebrity endorsements or retailer expansion as if they were known earlier
separate discovery-stage signals from confirmation-stage signals
a famous historical example cannot by itself prove predictive power
